description: This Java class defines a custom exception called JsonMissingFieldException used to signal that a required JSON field is missing during JSON processing. The class includes constructors, a builder pattern for fluent creation, and references to JSON field definitions and pointers.

classes.name: JsonMissingFieldException
classes.description: A custom exception thrown when a required JSON field is missing, extending JsonRuntimeException.

classes.name: JsonMissingFieldException.Builder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing instances of JsonMissingFieldException with fluent API.

methods.name: JsonMissingFieldException
methods.description: Constructs a new JsonMissingFieldException for a specific JSON key.

methods.name: JsonMissingFieldException
methods.description: Constructs a new JsonMissingFieldException for a JsonPointer of a specified JsonFieldDefinition.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Returns a new builder instance for creating JsonMissingFieldException objects.

methods.name: fieldName
methods.description: Sets the missing field name in the builder, either a single field or a hierarchy.

methods.name: doBuild
methods.description: Builds the JsonMissingFieldException instance with specified error details.
